challenge.method: Tested a case with zero Invariant Sections and one Front-Cover Text. Compared the version wording with the no-invariants-or-later record.
challenge.results: One Front-Cover Text defeats the all-absent condition even with zero Invariant Sections. The header fixes Version 1.3 and the ListedLicense identifier ends in -only. The addendum’s later-version example does not change that choice.

limitations: The three absences describe the identifier’s scope. Applying it to a work requires the work’s authorized notice.
reasoning: The SPDX ListedLicense spdxId is http://spdx.org/licenses/GFDL-1.3-no-invariants-only and its deprecation flag is false. Its header specifies Version 1.3 alone and expressly says “no Invariant Sections, no Front-Cover Texts, and no Back-Cover Texts”.
